As the day progresses, there is an 18% chance of isolated thunderstorms, which may bring some relief from the heat, but are not expected to lead to significant rainfall accumulation. In the evening, the temperature will dip to a low of 22°C, providing some respite from the daytime heat. The wind will be light and variable, blowing at a speed of 1 km/h, which will do little to alleviate the heat.
